title: acmella grandiflora
intro: Acmella grandiflora, commonly known as the "Parlor Plant" or "Squeeze Ball", is a tropical plant species native to South America. The health benefits of Acmella grandiflora include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of this plant include topical analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Acmella grandiflora include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
